notes: This contract traces HLAreflectionsReceived to its pinned standard MIM definition, receive-order attribute update and reflection, object registration, and direct MOM value requests. Installed-package runs are bounded provider evidence, not proof of provider-independent behavior or conformance.

requirements.statement: The standard MIM defines HLAreflectionsReceived as the total number of Reflect Attribute Values service invocations at the joined federate, distinguishing invocation count from the number of reflected object-attribute values. The scenario verifies one increment for each of three ordinary callbacks, including two callbacks for repeated updates to one object, then checks the final periodic value.
The publisher registers two application objects using the standard API; the receiving federate discovers both before updates are sent.

The publisher invokes receive-order Update Attribute Values three times. The test waits for a separate ordinary reflection callback after each invocation and requires HLAreflectionsReceived to advance by exactly one each time, even for two updates to the same object.
The monitor requests the standard scalar value from the subject federate's known MOM object and decodes the returned HLAinteger32BE value after each committed reflection callback.

The receiver records one distinct standard reflection callback per application update and validates object, typed attribute value, reliable transport, empty tag, producer federate, and the absence of DDM-region metadata.
